Armor: Each point of Armor reduces damage taken by 1, to a minimum of 1.
Damage: What one attack deals before Armor.
Health: Damage a thing can take before it dies or is destroyed.
Range: How far an ant attacks from.
Vision: How far an ant or structure sees, blocked by rock, dirt and walls.
Splash: Damage dealt to every enemy in an area.
Heal Rate: Health a Nurse Ant restores per heal.
Pop Cost: Population one ant of this species uses.
Population: The total Pop Cost of your ants.
Housing: Population your queens and brood cells support.
Pop Cap: The most Housing a colony can have: 300.
Housing Full: Training waits until you build more Housing.
Tier: Your colony's stage. Evolve to unlock species and upgrades.
Evolve: Pay to reach the next Tier.
Income: Resources delivered per second, over the last 10 seconds.
Gather Rate: How fast an ant fills its inventory at a node.
Carry Capacity: The most an ant's inventory holds.
Build Rate: How fast Carpenter Ants build a blueprint.
Saturated: A node with as many gatherers as it can use: 8.
Retreat: While on, every ant but Gatherers and Builders goes home.
Waypoint: Where every ant of one species goes. Right-click to clear.
All Ants: One waypoint for every combat species.
Train Max: Shift + Train: queue as many as you can pay for.
Blueprint: A placed outline; Carpenter Ants carry its cost there and build it.
Hatchery: Lets your colony train one species above Tier 1.
Queen: Trains Tier 1 species, takes deliveries and adds 20 Housing.
Wall: A barrier your ants pass and enemies must break.
Rock: Solid ground that cannot be destroyed.
Dirt: Ground your ants can dig through.
Cache: A rich one-off pile of resources.
Windfall: A cache that appears during the match.
Hill: A zone: the colony holding it longest wins a resource bundle.
Rank: An upgrade's level: I, II or III.
Gatherer: Gathers and delivers resources by itself.
Builder: Carries costs to blueprints and builds them.
Tank: Soaks damage with high Health or Armor.
Flyer: Flies over walls; rock and dirt still block.
Brute: Heavy melee: every hit deals Splash.
Bomber: Dies on purpose to deal Splash.
Duration: How long it takes, in seconds.
